name: Finite capacity scheduling
short_description: Finite capacity scheduling plans production operations onto real resource calendars, treating each machine, person or station as limited, so conflicts between orders become visible instead of being left to the shop floor.

evidence.quote: Finite capacity means the scheduler treats each resource as limited.
Finite capacity planning just means the schedule accepts that a resource can only do so much work
Finite capacity scheduling puts the plan through a tougher test.
Finite capacity scheduling doesn't create capacity.
Finite scheduling starts with one simple rule. Each resource only has the time it can actually provide.
